dialogs.title: About provider keys
paragraphs: Twitter / X uses your bearer token to search recent posts. OpenAI prepares news text. ElevenLabs generates all new voice audio.
Keys use protected storage when available. Session-only keys must be entered again after quitting. Saved recordings play without keys.
Provider keys apply to this app on this Mac when you switch music accounts. Signing out clears entered key text. A key change already saving can still finish.

Preparing text sends selected source content, news interests, DJ preferences, and mood to OpenAI. Generating audio sends the reviewed script and voice preferences to your chosen provider and uses that provider's account.

dialogs.title: About manual preparation
paragraphs: Use these tools to test a script or voice. Text and audio requests use your provider accounts and save completed results locally.
DJ playback only picks saved recordings. The news workflow prepares stories on its own schedule.
